name: Hatchet
description: A frontier hatchet with a steel head and a timber handle, balanced for throwing.
role: A tool that became a weapon: every timber crew carries one.

artBrief.silhouette: Short handle with a wedge head.
artBrief.detail: Grain lines on the handle and a bright edge on the steel head.
artBrief.spriteScale: Held by a 2×2 cell character; drawn over its skin.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)
